owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing
purpose: Provide one shared Discord engagement space where members from approved external communities can interact after opting into Reset Inner Circle.

access_model.member_action_required: Each participant must voluntarily join Reset Inner Circle through Discord.
access_model.optional_origin_attribution: Stored as public-safe campaign metadata for analytics and leader credit, not as private member data.

onboarding_flow: Facebook or other approved community referral reaches resetinnercircle.com
Referral source and partner slug are stored only as non-personal session attribution
Visitor joins Reset Inner Circle via Discord if not already a member
Code of Law / onboarding gate is completed
RESET Arena Member access is granted
Member enters the shared Main Arena regardless of originating community
Events, missions, collaboration calls, studio opportunities and creator resources branch outward from the Arena
expansion_rule: Do not create separate partner silos by default. The Arena is the common room; partner-specific rooms are exceptions requiring a demonstrated operational need.
